record.title: 同等逃生证据下优先减少静态退出步数
record.hypothesis: 在原有优先级完全打平时，静态退出步数比 robustLower 更能避免已知炸弹中的无进展转向。
record.scope: 诊断候选：单炸弹、无自身效果、COMMITTED_ESCAPE、证明及风险字段全相等，仅允许动作。
record.falsifier: 集成候选不触发或局部收益不达预设阈值，或出现任何证据/门槛违规。独立验证不支持则不得采纳。
record.nextStep: BP414 实现消融；通过后另登记数据审计与独立确认计划。

criteria.rule: all controls exact and zero violations

32 control signatures exact; all 32 candidate first handoffs choose GO; zero priority/gate violations; event survival gain >=0.5, exact one-sided paired sign p<=0.05 and positive both halves; mean score gain>=0.1 and positive both halves.

criteria.metric: paired score on independent terrain clusters
criteria.rule: Before independent testing, freeze audited data and precision plan in a child decision; require positive effect with uncertainty excluding zero and no safety regression.
Pass existing target runtime and release checks before adoption
